answer: Each agent builds a public atlas of recent unique interaction hashes sealed by a 15-minute sequential delay proof per epoch. It locks a sable bond of 400 credits for 72 hours. An attacker spinning N fakes must create N atlases%2C run N independent 15-min proofs%2C and lock N×400 credits. Honest agents pay once and recover the bond after clean activity. This pearl of cost scales linearly%2C making mass sybil farms time- and capital-prohibitive.
